root_idea.summary: A root orientation of breaking, pressing, and drawing parts into one another.
root_idea.development: The evidence develops this physical notion into softening and digestion, compact interpenetration in fruit, and figurative diminution or deprivation of a due.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic adjective has a distinct, explicitly explained usage in 26:148.
The Quranic verbal noun has a distinct figurative usage in 20:112.

senses.definition: Compacted, with its parts entering into one another as though crushed together.
senses.usage_conditions: In 26:148, said of the date-palm fruit or inflorescence and describing its parts as interpenetrating.

senses.definition: Wrongful diminution or deprivation of what is due; injustice by reducing another’s due.
senses.usage_conditions: In 20:112, paired with ظلم and used figuratively for deprivation or injustice, not for physical digestion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Crushing or breaking a soft substance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The physical action underlying the root’s descriptions of compacting, softening, and breaking down.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To relinquish or leave another a portion of one’s own right.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional construction concerning the surrender of part of a due or entitlement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To melt or dissolve after congealing; to break down, soften, or become easy to digest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive Form VII; reported of congealed matter, fruit, and food in the supplied attestations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A depression or sinking of the chest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical usage reported with qualification in the supplied attestation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To crop the tops of shrubs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form VIII usage concerning removal of the upper parts of shrubs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Contraction of the sides, lankness of the belly, or smallness of the flank.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In a horse, this bodily conformation is described as a fault.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A medicine or other agent that digests food; a digestive preparation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for something used to aid digestion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Highly digestive or able to digest food readily.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a stomach or belly with strong digestive capacity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Compressed or slender in the flank.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the side or flank, especially the كَشْح.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman described as delicate or slender in the two flanks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional bodily description specifying the two flanks.
A derived description for one characterized by wrongdoing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hollow or recessed part of a valley; أَهْضَام is the plural.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical usage for the depressed interiors of valleys.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Pointer-only cross-reference with no supplied definition.
Pointer-only cross-reference with no supplied definition.
Breaking, crushing, mellowing, and becoming easy to digest.
Qualified anatomical depression of the chest.
Contraction and narrowness of the sides or belly.

cautions: The supplied contextual rendering “soft” for هَضِيم in 26:148 is treated as support for the compacted/interpenetrating interpretation, not as a separate lexical sense.
The anatomical sense associated with اِنْهَضَامُ الزَّوْر is qualified in the supplied Classical attestation and is retained separately from the Quranic senses.
